text.markdown:
The Flats do not ask you to walk every culvert.

**Grey Cab** — a closed hover pod that answers a hail-ping. The meter wakes; the canopy seals; the street skims past under the next level’s belly. Quiet. Paid. Limiter-low — not a sky car.

**The Vein** — a teal-and-gunmetal district tram hung on Ferrum rails. Cheap seats, wet windows, every shift-change face in the hive. Public. Seen.

Both stay in the cushioned river. Both get you from Switchboard to Slackwater without inventing wings.
